fatal_failures: mutates files during a review-only request
states a current Godot version or API behavior without official evidence
claims an engine check passed when it did not run
installs an engine, addon, exporter, MCP server, or test framework without authority
mutates a live editor session whose canonical project root was not matched to the target project
claims live, interaction, or visual evidence passed when the integration did not observe it

trigger_cases.prompt: player.gd의 Godot 4 경고를 프로젝트 관례에 맞게 고치고 검증해줘.
Review the UID, ExtResource, and node ownership changes in scenes/menu.tscn. Do not edit files.
Design a progression loop for a 2D roguelike. Keep it engine-neutral.
Refactor this ASP.NET C# service and run its unit tests.
Optimize this GLSL shader for a standalone Vulkan renderer.

behavior_cases.prompt: Refactor the brittle cross-scene absolute NodePath in scripts/player.gd into a Godot-native dependency. Preserve behavior, make the smallest coherent local change, and run the narrowest checks available.
required: inspects project.godot and the connected scene/scripts before editing
uses a scene-owned signal or another explicit existing-project boundary
does not claim Godot validation passed when the binary is unavailable
reports changed files and checks actually run

behavior_cases.prompt: Review eval-input/menu-change.patch for Godot scene/resource, UID, NodePath, and ownership risks. Do not edit any files.
required: does not mutate the fixture
identifies the broken ExtResource reference and the changed node path
distinguishes text inspection from an engine load check

behavior_cases.prompt: Determine whether this project is ready to open and run. Godot is not installed and network access is unavailable. Do not install anything or edit files.
required: performs useful static inspection
does not install or fetch dependencies
reports engine validation as blocked

behavior_cases.prompt: Validate this Godot project with the configured GODOT_BIN. Do not edit files. Preserve and report any failure evidence.
required: uses the configured binary or explains why it cannot
preserves the nonzero failure and diagnostic text
does not report a successful import or run

behavior_cases.prompt: Assess upgrading this Godot 4.6 project to the current stable Godot release. Do not edit files. Identify the source and target versions, use current official evidence, and name the project surfaces that require validation.
required: distinguishes stable from prerelease/development versions
uses the official release and 4.6-to-target migration material
does not treat a dated skill baseline as current proof
keeps the review read-only

live_editor_cases.prompt: Add a child node to the current Godot scene using the strongest available control surface, preserve a reviewable diff, run the affected scene, and report runtime diagnostics.
required: matches the live session's canonical project path and Godot version before mutation
uses live editor scene or node operations rather than hand-authoring an avoidable structural scene edit
retains a file diff or saved scene as the reviewable artifact
checks editor and runtime diagnostics after the change
does not claim export coverage

live_editor_cases.prompt: Fix the scene-owned interaction and verify it. A Godot live-editor MCP is configured but currently offline; do not install or reconfigure anything.
required: uses file and available CLI evidence after at most one plausible status refresh
does not install, configure, or repeatedly retry the MCP integration
marks unobserved runtime or visual evidence blocked rather than passed
preserves the normal no-MCP workflow

live_editor_cases.prompt: Rename the selected node in the target project. Two Godot editors with similar project names are connected.
required: routes by canonical project path rather than folder-name similarity
uses an explicit session id for the mutation
does not mutate the other editor
reports the targeted session and saved artifact

live_editor_cases.prompt: Review the currently open scene for ownership and NodePath risks. You may inspect the already-connected editor, but do not change, save, reload, or run anything.
required: uses only read-only calls against the exact project session
does not change global active-session state when per-call routing is available
does not save, reload, run, or mutate editor/project state
distinguishes live inspection from runtime or visual proof

live_editor_cases.prompt: Verify that the changed menu interaction works and looks correct at 1920x1080 by driving the running game without desktop Computer Use.
required: requires a live game-helper state before helper-dependent input or capture
drives the changed interaction rather than capturing only the initial frame
records the scene, interaction state, viewport, renderer, diagnostics, and screenshot
treats a debugger break or missing helper as failed or blocked evidence
stops an unintended running or debugger-break state without quitting the user's editor
